name: NA64
summary: NA64 is a series of dedicated dark-sector fixed-target experiments in the CERN SPS North Area, Prévessin, France, operating since 2016.
detection_principle: A beam of known energy strikes an active target. Calorimeters seek large missing energy while vetoes reject ordinary particles escaping detection; visible decays are also sought. Electron, muon and hadron programs probe different couplings.

results.summary: NA64h searches for invisible decays of η and η′ produced by pion beams, demonstrating a hadron-beam dark-sector method.

science_scope: Tests dark-sector models by producing candidate particles or portal mediators at accelerators. Invisible accelerator final states or mediator particles alone do not establish cosmic-dark-matter identity; lifetimes, abundance and other experiments must also be considered.
